thread:
marta: Heads-up: planned base-image rebuild + KMS key rotation this Sat 03:00 UTC. Need to split builder SA perms (no signing) and give signer SA cosign+KMS-encrypt/decrypt only. Can we confirm RBAC changes, audit retention, and rollback playbook? cc @kevin @sam @roxana
kevin: Working on RBAC diff now. Plan: two k8s roles: image-builder (bake/push) and image-signer (cosign/sign). Will post YAML in a sec.
sam: Audit note: extend control-plane audit retention to 90d staging / 365d prod. Also route KMS envelope events to splunk index "kms-audit". Need ops help for logship.
roxana: Quick security Q: will cosign use the new KMS key directly (HSM) or via envelope? If HSM only available with special policy, we may need an ephemeral signing helper.
marta: If HSM policy blocks cosign, fallback is signer running on a dedicated signing pod in prod subnet with KMS access. Builders must not have decrypt.
kevin: RBAC snippet (WIP):
```
kind: Role
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
metadata:
  name: image-builder
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","secrets"]
  verbs: ["create","get","list"]
---
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: image-signer
rules:
- apiGroups: ["kms.services"]
  resources: ["keys/encrypt","keys/decrypt"]
  verbs: ["use"]
```
kevin: I'll put the full diff in PR #2768.
sam: Also add k8s policy that prevents builder role from binding to serviceaccounts with annotation `signer=true`. Defense in depth.
roxana: How do we preserve audit identity for cosign ops? We need the principal in logs, not just serviceaccount id. Maybe add --annotations to cosign so logs include signer email.
marta: Good call. Add `--annotations signer=svc-image-signer@redwood` to cosign invocation and emit structured JSON to stdout (so auditpipe / fluentd picks it up).
jin: I'll schedule a dry-run and add testcases to runbook: 1) rebuild + sign in staging, 2) verify image runtime verifies signature, 3) simulate KMS deny and ensure fallback works. ETA: dry-run Mon EOD.
build-bot: deploy-bot: staging rebuild job queued: job/regen-base:3456 started
kevin: Also adding a k8s webhook check: reject RoleBindings that grant builders decrypt on keys. Short snippet: `if role.rules contains keys/decrypt and subject.matches builder -> deny`
sam: Ops: make sure KMS IAM binding grants decrypt only to `svc-image-signer@redwood-prod` (principle-of-least-privilege). No decrypt for builder SAs.
roxana: If KMS rotation fails mid-run, what's our abort window? Who's primary?
marta: I will be primary owner for rotation. Jin is backup. If rotation errors, abort rebuild, keep previous signing key and requeue after manual verification. Runtime routing will fall back to previous tag if verification fails.
jin: oncall-bot: scheduled dry-run for Mon 2026-03-30 15:00 UTC
kevin: PR #2768 opened with RBAC + webhook + e2e checklist. Adding unit test for role deny logic.
sam: LGTM pending tests and ops confirmation on log shipping. Please ensure audit retention is configured before prod cutover.
roxana: One more: cosign keywrap policies — we'll need a KMS IAM condition to restrict key usage to the signer SA and to time window of the rebuild. Can ops help craft the condition?
marta: Ops/infra: can you propose the IAM condition text? I want a time-bound condition for the rotation window.
jin: I'll draft the condition and post in PR. Also will add an alert: `cosign.verify.errors > 0.5%` for 5m -> page.
marta: Thanks everyone. I'll collate items and send calendar invite for Saturday window. Post any blockers here. :thumbsup:
kevin: small follow-up: ensure image registry has signed-tag retention policy so we don't accidentally GC fallback images.
sam: noted. I'll add retention rule: keep last 30 signed tags for each base image.
roxana: If anything unforeseen pops during dry-run, tag me immediately.
marta: Will do. Closing thread for now unless someone raises a blocker.
kevin: TY.
jin: Thanks.
